content.text:
I wrote the renderer in `src/markdown.js`. It exports `render(markdown)` and covers every item in the SPEC subset. I wrote the code myself with no outside sources, so `PROVENANCE.json` is `[]`.

`node --test` passes, but the only test is the one public smoke test. Beyond that I checked a few sample inputs by hand. I didn't compare the output against commonmark.js.

Beyond the SPEC:
- Setext headings (`Title` over `---` or `===`) render as headings, which is what CommonMark does for `---` under a paragraph line.
- Indented code blocks, hard line breaks, entity decoding and loose lists are handled.
- Lists and blockquotes can nest, so they aren't limited to a single level.

I didn't add reference-style links. Only inline `[text](url)` links are supported.
